rationale: S-0090-04 proposes tightening t0091's LHS morphology bounds by fitting per-axis empirical bounds to the 9 STABLE cells from the t0090 diversity sweep, on the premise that 51/60 morphologies failed NAN_VOLTAGE under the fixed t0083 best-cell channel set. t0093's patched-generator re-sweep made 60/60 cells STABLE-firing under that same channel set, with 56/60 having PD-rate>0 and 0 regressions. The 9 STABLE pool was an artefact of the soma-pt3d collapse bug, not a real signal about which morphology parameter ranges produce stable cells. The tightening rationale is therefore invalidated, and using the original wide LHS bounds is correct for t0091. Rejecting as premise-falsified.
